title: 117 more OFWs return from Saudi Arabia amid Mideast tensions

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A total of 117 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) from Saudi Arabia returned to the Philippines through government-assisted voluntary repatriation amid continuing tensions in the Middle East. The OFWs arrived at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 3 on Sunday, Oct. 25, aboard Gulf Air flight GF154 and Qatar Airways flight QR928, with the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) and the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) facilitating their return. “Ang pagpapauwi sa 117 OFWs ay bahagi ng Saving Lives component ng Unified Package for Livelihoods, Industry, Food, Transport (UPLIFT) initiative ng pamahalaan, alinsunod sa direktiba ni Pangulong Ferdinand R.
